metadata.description: Post variant templates, reply angle templates, and hard rules

post_variants.name: Hook-Accuracy
post_variants.example:
$47M for a 2-person AI startup.

Anthropic led a Series B for a tool that writes 73% of its own features.

500-person dev teams building simple apps: era ending.

Source: TechCrunch

post_variants.name: Value-Driven
post_variants.strategy: Lead with reader benefit — framework, insight, takeaway
post_variants.example:
3 things GPT-5's benchmark reveals for your workflow:

1. Multimodal reasoning is production-ready
2. 1M token context changes RAG architecture
3. Code generation = mid-level engineer quality

Adapt now or spend Q4 catching up.

post_variants.name: Data Bomb
post_variants.example:
89.7%.

GPT-5's accuracy on medical diagnosis — outperforming the average doctor.

Not replacing doctors. Giving every clinic a second opinion that never sleeps.

Source: OpenAI technical report

post_variants.name: Founder-Focused
post_variants.example:
Dario Amodei bet Anthropic's future on safety as a moat.

Claude self-corrects harmful outputs 94% of the time without human oversight.

If safety becomes a competitive advantage, the careful companies win.

post_variants.name: Technical Deep
post_variants.strategy: One specific technical detail most coverage misses
post_variants.example:
GPT-5 uses MoE with 128 experts, activates only 12 per token.

Result: 10x cheaper than dense model of equivalent capability.

A router learned which expert handles which concept.

Paper: arxiv.org/xxxx

reply_angles.name: Add Insight
reply_angles.trigger_when: Original makes claim you can strengthen with data

reply_angles.name: Respectful Counter
reply_angles.strategy: Disagree with ONE point using evidence
reply_angles.trigger_when: Original makes claim you know is inaccurate AND you have evidence

reply_angles.name: Build On Idea
reply_angles.trigger_when: Original identifies trend but doesn't explore implications

reply_angles.name: Ask Clarifying
reply_angles.trigger_when: Original presents data/claims that raise follow-up questions

reply_angles.name: Share Experience
reply_angles.trigger_when: You have direct personal experience with the topic
